input.final_sql:
select r.BEN_RES_REG_LIB, sum(f.PRS_REM_MNT) as total_reimbursed
from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS f
left join ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION r on f.BEN_RES_REG = r.BEN_RES_REG
group by r.BEN_RES_REG_LIB

final_sql:

from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS f

group by r.BEN_RES_REG_LIB
